messages:
Ivy: Quick heads up — legal flagged that Hong Kong (hk-1) needs an explicit availability + data residency note before we ship the SDK sample. Can someone update the Node & Python snippets? Link: https://redwood.ai/docs/regions

Raj: Ok, lemme take Node. Are we adding a new endpoint or just an env var? Current pattern is `https://api.redwood.ai/v1` — we probably need a region-specific host like `https://api.hk.redwood.ai` or an `REDWOOD_API_HOST` example.

Ivy: Legal wants a short sentence: "Data for projects in the hk-1 region is processed and stored in Hong Kong unless customers enable cross-region replication." Also call out that customers must opt into hk-1 in project settings. Please add an env var example: `REDWOOD_REGION=hk-1`.

Sam: I'll do Python. Suggest we add a fallback note: if hk capacity isn't available the request will route to the nearest APAC region and we'll surface that in headers.

Marco: Small suggestion — prefer `api_host` config in the SDK snippet instead of string concatenation. Makes it clearer for mobile devs.

docs-bot: PR opened by raj: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234 — adds Node snippet + hk note

Ivy: Great. Sam can you link your PR to raj's and ping @eng-infra for any host config validation we should mention in the SDK reference?

Sam: Done — PR #1235. Added fallback sentence and a tiny unit test to ensure the snippet builds the host correctly from env.

Raj: Updated Node sample. Snippet:
```js
// Node example
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiHost: process.env.REDWOOD_API_HOST || 'https://api.hk.redwood.ai' })
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hello' })
console.log(res)
```

Sam: Python snippet:
```py
# Python example
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_host=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_HOST', 'https://api.hk.redwood.ai'))
res = client.generate('hello')
print(res)
```

Ivy: Nice. Please add a one-line entry to the "Supported regions" table: "HK (hk-1): available; data stored in-region unless cross-region replication is enabled." Keep it concise and add the anchor id `#regions-hk-1`.

Raj: Added table row + anchor, and fixed anchor collisions. Also ran the mobile snippet renderer — looks good.

docs-bot: merged PRs #1234 and #1235 — deployment scheduled for 2025-06-15 04:00 UTC

Ivy: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up if legal requests stronger language.

Sam: lgtm :shipit:

Raj: :thumbsup:
